detail_text: 1. This is a Sources Sought Synopsis for market research purposes only, issued by the U.S. Air Force. This is not a Request for Quotation (RFQ) or a Request for Proposal (RFP). The Government is seeking to identify qualified business sources, particularly small businesses, capable of providing the National Stock Number (NSN) items listed below, which must be compliant with Military Performance Specification MIL-PRF-370J . 2. The Government requires the following items. The listed Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) part numbers are provided for reference only to describe the form, fit, and function of the required items.
